author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a swinging beat, up and down, loud and soft, stop and go, and playing together, with the climbing spider song.

classes.title: Sway with the spider
classes.goal: Feel the swinging beat of the song with the whole body.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a swing that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child on your lap and sway gently side to side on each big beat.
classes.childAction: Sway and pat your knees with the song.
classes.bridge: The beat swings like a spider on its thread: swing, swing, swing.

intro.caption: Let's swing like a spider
intro.parentCue: child on your lap, sway gently

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the swinging beat, together.

classes.title: Spider steps
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each big beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each beat. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one spider step up the spout; one tap for each step.

intro.caption: One step, one tap
intro.parentCue: walk two fingers up your child's arm

games.caption: Climbed up the water spout
games.parentCue: Walk your fingers up on each tap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sounds can climb up and slide down, like the spider

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch and growl for the bear; stretch up and flap for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear on the left; high notes, a bird up the spout.

intro.caption: Bear lives low, bird lives high
intro.parentCue: point left for bear, right for bird

games.caption: Climb up, rain comes down
games.parentCue: Lift your child's hand up, then let it float down

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low, up and down.

classes.title: Big sun, little rain
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Make big strong arms for loud taps; wiggle soft raindrop fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big sunshine taps. Soft: tiny raindrop taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are the big bright sun; soft taps are little drops of rain.

intro.caption: Big sun, tiny raindrops
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Slow spider, fast spider
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's arm, slowly then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are a sleepy spider climbing; fast taps are a spider in a hurry.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny climbs the spout
games.parentCue: Same song, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Rain stop, spider freeze
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while the music plays. Freeze like a spider when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the spider climbs; music off, the spider holds very still.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... freeze!
intro.parentCue: make freezing silly, like a statue

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Tap it-sy bit-sy
classes.goal: Tap one tap for each sung word piece, saying the words together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each piece of a word we sing gets one tap

classes.parentPrompt: Say the words slowly with your child and tap their hand on every word piece.
classes.childAction: Say the words and tap one tap for each piece.
classes.bridge: Little words are little spider steps: it-sy bit-sy spi-der.

intro.caption: Tap with the words
intro.parentCue: say the words slowly, tap each piece

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each word piece.

classes.title: Guess the music game
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, fast and slow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound wears a costume: bear, bird, sun, rain, turtle or bunny.

intro.caption: What game is it?
intro.parentCue: let your child guess first; any guess is fine

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: You and me, spider duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The tune is the spider climbing; your beat is the spout that holds it.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Spider concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The song is the spider's day: climb, rain, sun, then climb again.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
